main_text.p: solem tam nigrum surrexêre mihi ! Hor. Adversâ fortunâ uti. Vid. Evenit malè.
Successio] Successio in locum alicujus. Consequentia. Consecutio voluptatis,Cic. Sequela morborum mors,Lact. Consequium, Apul.
Successivus] Succidaneus, i. succedaneus, Gell. Successorius,Vlp. Consectarius, Cic. Vid. Consequens.

Successus bonus aut malus] Successum, Ovid. Queruntur semper de processibus suis, Sen. Fortuna secunda, prospera, florens, adversa. Felicitas, Prosperitas. Sors atrox, tr. jucunda. Eventus. Eventum. Casus. Incerti exitus pugnarum, Marsque communis,Cic. Mars varius, Quint. Proventus felicitatis, Val. Maxim. Sors pessima rerum, Ovid.
Succisivus] Subsecivus : Subseciva quædam tempora incurrunt,quæ ego perire non patior, Cic. Subseciva temporum,Quint. Subsecundaria & subseciva tempora,Gell. Surreptitius, Plaut.
Succrescere] Increscit hulcus, &c. Subnascuntur plumæ, Plaut. Supercrescit aliquid, Quint. Grandescere, Plin.

Succumbere] Succumbere oneri. Concidere sub onere, Liv. Opprimi onere, Cic. Concidere, procumbere pondere, Virg. Cedere ponderi, Quint. Dare manus. Porrigere herbam. Lampada tradere. Vid. Dedere, subdere se.

Sudare] Sudore manare, Cic. Fluit, manat sudor è, de corpore, Lucr. Ovid. Emittere sudorem, Plin. Elicere, evocare. Sudor oritur, effuditur, Cels. Exsudare,Col. Desudare, Stat. Desudascere, Plaut. Assudescere, Varr. Circumsudare,Plin. Consudare, consudascere, Col. Praesudare, Stat.
Sudatorium] Assa,pl. Laconicum, Cic. Sudatio,abs.Vitr. Sudatio assa, Cels. Caldarium, Vitr. Caldaria cella, Plin. Sudatoria cella, Sen. Tepidaria, & Frigidaria, Vouver. Balnearia,(pl. locus) Cic.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page is present throughout and was omitted. Some words in the dictionary entries are uncertain due to print quality (e.g. "Consequium", "Sors atrox"), and "Vouver." and "Desudascere" may be misprints for the printed forms; left as printed.
